definition_quote.value: a person who, on written prescription from a licensed physician or optometrist, prepares and dispenses to the intended wearer or person who writes the prescription, original or duplicate lenses, eyeglasses, contact lenses, and appurtenances to them, and interprets, measures, adapts, fits, and adjusts lenses, eyeglasses, contact lenses, and appurtenances to them in accordance with the written prescription, to the face for the aid or correction of visual or ocular anomalies of the human eye
definition_quote.quote: "dispensing optician" means a person who, on written prescription from a licensed physician or optometrist, prepares and dispenses to the intended wearer or person who writes the prescription, original or duplicate lenses, eyeglasses, contact lenses, and appurtenances to them, and interprets, measures, adapts, fits, and adjusts lenses, eyeglasses, contact lenses, and appurtenances to them in accordance with the written prescription, to the face for the aid or correction of visual or ocular anomalies of the human eye

value: prepare and dispense lenses, eyeglasses, contact lenses, and appurtenances

license_tier_structure.quote: A license shall be issued for (1) the dispensing of contact lenses, or (2) the dispensing of other lenses, eyeglasses, spectacles, artificial eyes, and their appurtenances, or (3) both.

contact_lens_scope_included.quote: A license shall be issued for (1) the dispensing of contact lenses

artificial_eye_scope_included.quote: the dispensing of other lenses, eyeglasses, spectacles, artificial eyes, and their appurtenances

duplicate_without_prescription_allowed.quote: In no case may contact lenses be prepared by neutralizing a person's eyeglasses or spectacles.

written_prescription_required.quote: on written prescription from a licensed physician or optometrist, prepares and dispenses to the intended wearer or person who writes the prescription, original or duplicate lenses, eyeglasses, contact lenses, and appurtenances to them

contact_lens_followup_required.quote: with a written contact-lens prescription showing that the prescription may be filled for contact lenses and requiring that the patient return to see the prescribing physician or optometrist

contact_lens_supervision_required.quote: Contact lenses shall be fitted in conjunction with and under the supervision of a licensed physician or an optometrist

apprentice_to_supervisor_ratio_limit.quote: No more than two apprentices may be under the direct supervision of one licensed dispensing optician at the same time.

unlicensed_assistant_tasks_permitted.quote: a person who is not a licensed dispensing optician or a registered apprentice under AS 08.71.160 may perform dispensing optician tasks that are delegated by and performed under the regular supervision of a licensed physician, optometrist, or dispensing optician

advertising_eye_exam_claim_prohibited.quote: authorize or permit a licensee under this chapter to hold out as being able to, or to offer to, or to attempt by any means, to refract or exercise eyes, diagnose, treat, correct, relieve, operate, or prescribe for any human ailment, deficiency, deformity, disease, or injury
